missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Температура' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Высокая' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'сегодня' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Температуру' is the accusative direct object of 'измерил'; the feminine ending -а shifts to -у. 'Утром' is an instrumental-derived time adverb.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет' the noun takes the genitive 'температуры'. 'У ребёнка' is a genitive possession frame, a common medical phrase.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. The adjective 'чувствительны' with 'к' takes the dative 'температуре'. A natural way to express sensitivity to something.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after за. The verb 'следить за' takes the instrumental 'температурой'. 'Воды' is a genitive specifying the temperature of what.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'при' the noun takes the prepositional 'температуре'. 'Высокой' is the agreeing feminine prepositional adjective.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Температуру' is the accusative object of 'держу'. 'Под контролем' is a fixed instrumental phrase meaning under control.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Температуры' is the nominative plural, the subject of 'падают'. 'Зимой' is an instrumental-derived time adverb, and 'резко' adds manner.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Температуры' is the accusative plural object of 'сравнивают'; this inanimate feminine plural matches the nominative. 'Разные' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive of specification. 'Температуры' is the genitive showing the change of what. 'На погоду' is an accusative phrase after 'влиять на'.
